notes:
Zaiqa Billing, Zaiqa Waiter, Zaiqa Kitchen, Zaiqa Stock and Zaiqa Staff apps, version 2.36.0.

Staff requests, leave rules, calendar colours, Service / Take away
- POS: a small line at the top ("📝 2 staff requests · …") when employees send requests. It hides once you open the Requests tab.
- Staff app: "Add a missed day" for past days of the CURRENT month only (default 3 days back, 3 requests a month). Needs your approval; old, future, paid-month and already-recorded days are refused automatically.
- Leave rules in Settings: leave on/off, paid leave days per month (shop default, or per person under Edit). Extra days are approved as unpaid.
- Staff calendar: solid coloured dates (present, late, absent, leave, unpaid leave, day off), waiting requests shown dashed, ✓ for days you approved, today outlined, with a legend.
- Waiter app: in Review order every item has Service / Take away counters (default all Service). Take-away lines show "(Take away)" on the kitchen slip and bill.
